# Alert Display Checklist: IP Verdict Display That Keeps the Policy's Distinctions

**Purpose**: Unit tests for the requirements of spec 057. They cover four areas:

- the alarm's integrity;
- how each surface presents the state;
- the API and agent contract;
- cross-layer consistency and the failure states.

**Created**: 2026-09-29
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [contracts/](../contracts/)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Is today's exposed presentation listed in full, surface by surface? Today it includes the pulsing mark on the HUD and the card, and the card's Exposed IP list hint. FR-002 names neither, so SC-003 cannot be checked item by item. [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §SC-003]
- [x] CHK002 Does the spec say what pass-through and the HUD's opacity do when an alarm ends? Does pass-through stay off, as today, or return to the operator's setting? [Gap, Spec §FR-002, §FR-006]
- [x] CHK003 Is there an acceptance scenario for "still checking"? It should say what replaces the state when the first lookup succeeds, and when it fails. A failure there has no address and no last reading to show. [Coverage, Spec §FR-001, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK004 Does a requirement cover the CLI's status output, or is the CLI only a reader of the API's values? The spec names the CLI as a reader, but no requirement says what it prints. [Gap, Spec §FR-018]
- [x] CHK005 Is agent behaviour specified for the states that make no claim? These are "still checking", and no current reading without an earlier exposed or off-profile reading. Or is "proceed as today" stated as the intent? [Coverage, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK006 Are the documents this feature updates named, with their sections? The candidates are:
  - ALERT-ROLES A.2 and A.3;
  - UIUX-STANDARD §1;
  - TESTING.md §1.8, §5.1, §5.2 and G-UI2;
  - the three agent-facing documents;
  - the CHANGELOG.

  [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions, §FR-019]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Is "held open" defined? The spec should say whether it blocks only the automatic collapse or a collapse by hand as well, and whether the HUD opens when it receives an alarm that is already under way. [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, §FR-006, §FR-016]
- [x] CHK008 Does the spec say where each surface shows the hint, the last reading, the address's age and the confirming indicator? The candidates are the HUD's compact bar, the HUD's expanded pane, the status bar and the dashboard card. [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, §FR-011, §FR-016, §FR-017]
- [x] CHK009 Is it stated that the age of the last reading, and of the last known address, counts from the last successful read and not from the last attempt? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, §FR-016]
- [x] CHK010 Is "short" in the narrow-status-bar edge case bounded by something that can be measured? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK011 Does each hint requirement name its fix precisely enough that a candidate wording can be judged against it? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, §FR-007, §FR-009, §FR-010, §FR-012]
- [x] CHK012 Is "the reason when it is known" a closed list, and is it clear which of the reasons the operator can tell apart? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, §US4]
- [x] CHK013 Is "a qualified mark that is neither a solid fill nor a glow" specific enough to tell a compliant mark from one that is not? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK014 Do FR-003 and FR-016 agree on how a held no-current-reading state looks? It keeps the exposed alarm's HUD overrides without its label, red, pulse or flash. [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, §FR-016, §US1]
- [x] CHK015 Is the confirming indicator treated the same way in FR-001, FR-013, FR-017 and FR-018: as an indicator that goes with a state, never as a state of its own? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, §FR-013, §FR-017, §FR-018]
- [x] CHK016 Are "no current reading", "failed read", "stale" and "air-gap" each used in one sense across the stories, the requirements and the key entities? US4 opens with "when the last lookup failed" and then lists air-gap mode as a reason. Its scenario 4 says air-gap mode is not a failed lookup. [Consistency, Spec §US4, §FR-009, §FR-010, §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK017 Does the Assumptions list of the IP state's consumers match what reads it today? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK018 Does SC-001 name the expected state for each A.1 cell, and for a failed read, air-gap mode and "still checking"? Today it says only "the state the policy decided". [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK019 Is SC-003's "in every trial" defined, or replaced by a check of each behaviour? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK020 Can SC-004's walkthrough be repeated? It should say who performs it, on which surfaces, and in which languages. [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK021 Does every acceptance scenario name the surfaces it applies to, or rely on a requirement that makes the state uniform across them? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §US1–§US5, §FR-014]
- [x] CHK022 Is each MUST NOT phrased so that it can be checked for every state, not only for the state it names? [Measurability, Spec §FR-003, §FR-004, §FR-005, §FR-007, §FR-008, §FR-012, §FR-017]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK023 Are the transitions between alarm states covered? They are exposed to off-profile, the reverse, and either one to a held no-current-reading state and back. [Coverage, Spec §US1, §US3, §FR-016]
- [x] CHK024 Is recovery specified for each no-current-reading case? The cases are a failed read, air-gap mode being turned off, and a held alarm. [Coverage, Recovery, Spec §US4, §FR-010, §FR-016]
- [x] CHK025 Is the migration covered for an API consumer that tested the old `exposed` value, so that it keeps stopping where it stopped before? [Coverage, Spec §FR-019, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK026 Does the spec say whether turning air-gap mode on after an exposed or off-profile reading keeps the alarm held, as a failed read does? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-010, §FR-016]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK027 Is the hint defined for a failed read when no list is set? It could be the network hint, the set-the-lists hint, or both. [Edge Case, Spec §FR-009, §FR-012]
- [x] CHK028 Is it specified what happens when a read fails while a new address is being confirmed? The spec should also say what shows when the next successful read returns an address that is still unconfirmed. [Edge Case, Spec §FR-016, §FR-017, §US5]
- [x] CHK029 Is it specified how a settings change or a project switch affects a held alarm? [Gap, Spec §FR-016, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK030 Is the both-lists case (A-6) bounded explicitly, so that leaving the list conflict off the display is a decision and not an omission? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK031 Is it covered what a surface shows when it opens while an alarm is already held, such as the HUD being shown or the dashboard mounting? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-014]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK032 Does the colour-free requirement cover the confirming indicator and the held-alarm line, as well as the states? [Accessibility, Spec §FR-013, §FR-016, §FR-017]
- [x] CHK033 Are contrast requirements stated for the new orange tone, matching the design standard's floors for text and for marks? [Accessibility, Gap, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK034 Is it stated how soon a surface must reflect a new status? Or is "the next status it receives" the intended bound, given that a status is pushed on every read? [Non-Functional, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK035 Is it specified that the candidate address is revealed nowhere, the status API included? [Privacy, Spec §FR-017, §FR-018]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK036 Does a named test back the assumption that the policy's decisions (ALERT-ROLES A.1) are correct? The display requirements rest on it. [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK037 Is the amendment to ALERT-ROLES A.3 rule 1 acknowledged? That rule says a stale exposed verdict decays to unknown. Without the acknowledgement, FR-016's held alarm contradicts the design reference. [Conflict, Spec §FR-016, §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK038 Are the two design references reconciled? ALERT-ROLES A.2 gives off-profile orange. UIUX-STANDARD §1's state table has no orange, and its "warn" is amber. [Conflict, Spec §FR-006, §Assumptions]

- 2026-09-29: Claude evaluated the checklist at the reviewer's request, against the spec at `3c3eb54` plus the fixes below. 13 items passed as written. CHK021 and CHK031 pass through the fixes for CHK008 and CHK007. The other 25 failed at first, and the spec was fixed before they were checked:
  - CHK001, CHK019: FR-002 lists the exposed presentation surface by surface, including the pulsing mark and the card's hint. FR-003 adds the pulsing mark. SC-003 checks each behaviour FR-002 lists.
  - CHK002: new edge case "An alarm ends": the HUD returns to its resting opacity, and pass-through stays off, as today.
  - CHK003: US4 scenario 6 covers still checking, and a first lookup that succeeds or fails.
  - CHK004: FR-018 says the CLI prints the same state and says when an alarm is held.
  - CHK005: FR-019 says an agent reports the no-claim states and does not stop for them, as today.
  - CHK006: Assumptions name every document and section to update.
  - CHK007: FR-002 defines "held open": the HUD opens when it receives an alarm while not showing one, does not collapse on its own, and can still be collapsed by hand.
  - CHK008: FR-001 says what the status bar, the HUD's bar and pane, and the card each show.
  - CHK009: FR-011 says every age counts from the last successful read.
  - CHK010: the status-bar edge case is bounded by the width that today's exposed label and an address take.
  - CHK016: US4 no longer calls air-gap mode a failed lookup.
  - CHK017: Assumptions name bookmarks as a reader of the address, and leave them out of scope.
  - CHK018: SC-001 names the expected state for each A.1 cell, a failed read, air-gap mode and still checking.
  - CHK020: SC-004's walkthrough covers every state, surface and language.
  - CHK026: FR-016 covers air-gap mode turned on after an exposed or off-profile reading.
  - CHK027: FR-012 settles the hint for a failed read with no list set.
  - CHK028: new edge case: a read that fails while a new address is being confirmed.
  - CHK029: new edge case: a settings change or a project switch while an alarm is held.
  - CHK032: FR-013 covers the confirming indicator and the last-reading line.
  - CHK033, CHK038: Assumptions set the orange's contrast floors, and add it to UIUX-STANDARD §1's state table.
  - CHK035: FR-017 extends the ban on showing the candidate address to the status API.
  - CHK036: Assumptions name the test that pins the policy's decisions.
  - CHK037: Assumptions acknowledge the amendment to ALERT-ROLES A.3 rule 1.

  `contracts/surfaces.md` was brought into line: where the held-alarm line shows, "held open", and the settling indicator during a failed read. The reviewer can uncheck any item.
